sample_unit: Reddit posts (plus 60,782 WebMD reviews and FDA FAERS records)
unlisted_practices: Provenance-aware knowledge graph that keeps regulatory adverse-event facts distinct from patient-reported experience
Benchmarking LLM entity recognition against physician annotations
Cross-source concordance analysis of patient-generated data versus regulatory reports as a safety signal

screen.reason: The paper develops and evaluates an automated multi-agent LLM pipeline and knowledge graph to aggregate and trace psychiatric medication information from online patient narratives and FDA adverse event reports.
